hook.text: Beyond weddings: milestone birthdays, anniversaries, and graduations are becoming bookable hotel events with premium packages.

buildup.text: The 50th birthday market generates billions. Baby boomers celebrate with multi-day destination parties rivaling weddings.

discovery.text: Hotels now market 'celebration concierges'—staff who plan milestone events from surprise proposals to retirement parties.

twist.text: Social media transformed celebrations into content events. If it's not Instagrammable, it didn't happen.

climax.text: The celebration event segment grows 10% annually. People spend more on experiences and milestones as material consumption.

punchline.text: Not just weddings anymore. Every milestone is now a bookable, Instagrammable hotel event.

quiz.question: Why are celebration events growing as a hotel revenue segment?
options: People increasingly spend on experiences over material goods—milestone celebrations grow 10% annually
